explanation: In Spain, public displays of affection such as hugging, kissing on the cheeks, and holding hands are common and socially accepted, especially in social gatherings. However, more intimate gestures like passionate kissing may be seen as inappropriate in formal or mixed-age settings. The culture is warm and tactile, but discretion is appreciated in conservative circles.
local_tip: Greet with two kisses (right then left) among friends and acquaintances, but avoid prolonged or overly intimate embraces in formal social gatherings.
regional_note: In more conservative regions like Andalusia or rural areas, older generations may be more reserved, while in cosmopolitan cities like Madrid or Barcelona, younger crowds are very open.

also_check.note: Public displays of affection are rare and considered impolite, even between couples.
Kissing on the cheeks as a greeting is standard, but more intimate PDA is common and accepted.
Any public displays of affection between unrelated men and women are illegal and severely frowned upon.
